usedFor: Shopify holds products and orders, and Linguin AI reports the language of their text through “Detect Language”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Detect Language” in Linguin AI
bestTemplate.why: A new product listing carries text, and the action returns each language with a confidence score.

watchOut: “Detect Language” returns a confidence score, so decide what score is good enough before acting on the result.
